title: IDTA AAS Submodel SemanticIds (phase-0 surface)
description:
Registry of the IDTA Asset Administration Shell
semanticIds emitted by the OpenEPCIS AAS phase-0 builders, with graded SKOS
mappings to the GS1 Web Vocabulary master data those builders read. Covers the
Digital Nameplate 3.0 (IDTA 02006), ContactInformations 1.0 (IDTA 02002) and
DPP Metadata submodels. admin-shell.io semanticIds keep their upstream IRIs;
IEC CDD / ECLASS elements are identified by IRDIs, which are not IRIs, so they
carry a local node here with the verbatim IRDI in skos:notation. Deliberately
NOT a full mapping of the templates — only the builder surface.

classes.label: Email
classes.comment: ContactInformation collection (ECLASS AAQ836): the SubmodelElementCollection grouping the e-mail properties. A structural container, so it carries no graded mapping of its own; the value inside is EmailAddress.

classes.label: DPP Metadata (Submodel)
classes.comment: semanticId of the DPP Metadata submodel as emitted by the OpenEPCIS AAS phase-0 builder. Carries the passport header; its properties are identified by semanticIds formed as {submodel semanticId}/{idShort}.

classes.label: Digital Nameplate (Submodel)
classes.comment: semanticId of the Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment submodel, template version 3.0 (IDTA 02006-3-0), as emitted by the OpenEPCIS AAS phase-0 builder. Its elements are identified by IEC CDD IRDIs; the ones the builder populates are listed below.

classes.label: ContactInformations (Submodel)
classes.comment: semanticId of the ContactInformations submodel, template version 1.0 (IDTA 02002-1-0), as emitted by the OpenEPCIS AAS phase-0 builder. The template predates the idta path segment, so the zvei namespace is upstream's own and is preserved verbatim. Its elements are identified by ECLASS IRDIs; the ones the builder populates are listed below.

properties.label: CityTown
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO132): city or town. Filled verbatim from the GS1 postal address locality.

properties.label: Company
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAW001): name of the company. Filled from the GS1 organization name of the contact party — the same brand-owner-before-manufacturer choice as ManufacturerName, hence close, not exact.

properties.label: CountryOfOrigin
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABP462): country where the product was manufactured. GS1 models the origin against its country code lists while the CDD element is a plain string, so the relation is close, not exact.

properties.label: EmailAddress
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO198): e-mail address, inside the Email collection. Filled verbatim from the GS1 contact e-mail.

properties.label: globalAssetId
properties.comment: AAS meta-model attribute (AssetInformation/globalAssetId, IEC 63278) — an attribute of the shell itself rather than a submodel element, so it has no semanticId and is carried as a local node. The phase-0 builder fills it with the canonical GS1 Digital Link URI (id.gs1.org): the same identity that appears as URIOfTheProduct and in the DPP Metadata header.

properties.label: digitalProductPassportId
properties.comment: DPP Metadata header property: the passport identifier. The phase-0 builder fills it with the canonical GS1 Digital Link URI (id.gs1.org) — the identity bridge of the platform. In the GS1 Web Vocabulary rendering, that URI is the JSON-LD node identity (@id); gs1:productID is the property stand-in the project uses where identity must appear as a property (the EN 18223 envelope makes the same move).

properties.label: granularity
properties.comment: DPP Metadata header property: model, batch, or item. The phase-0 builder derives it from the GS1 Digital Link Application Identifiers (01 model, 01+10 batch, 01+21 item), not from a GS1 master-data field, so no graded mapping is asserted.

properties.label: uniqueProductIdentifier
properties.comment: DPP Metadata header property: the ESPR unique product identifier. The phase-0 builder fills it with the canonical GS1 Digital Link URI (id.gs1.org), identical to digitalProductPassportId and to the AAS globalAssetId — one identity, emitted at every AAS anchor point.

properties.label: ManufacturerName
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABA565): legally valid designation of the natural or judicial person placing the product on the market. The phase-0 builder takes the organization name of the brand owner before the manufacturer, so the GS1 organization name is close but not identical in referent; the brand name serves as a further fallback.

properties.label: ManufacturerProductDesignation
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABA567): short description of the product. Filled from the GS1 product name — a consumer-facing name rather than a manufacturer designation, hence close, not exact.

properties.label: NationalCode
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO134): country code. Both sides carry ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, so the match is exact.

properties.label: OrderCodeOfManufacturer
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABA950): unique combination of characters identifying the product for ordering. The phase-0 builder fills it with the GTIN-14 by convention — in the GS1 world the GTIN IS the order code — but the concepts are not the same, so the relation stays related, not graded closer.

properties.label: SerialNumber
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABA951): unique combination of characters identifying the individual item. Filled verbatim from the GS1 serial number (AI 21).

properties.label: Street
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO128): street name and house number. Filled verbatim from the GS1 postal address street.

properties.label: TelephoneNumber
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO136): telephone number. Filled verbatim from the GS1 contact telephone.

properties.label: URIOfTheProduct
properties.comment: Digital Nameplate element (IEC CDD ABN590): unique global identification of the product using a universal resource identifier. The phase-0 builder fills it with the canonical GS1 Digital Link URI (id.gs1.org) — the node identity of the GS1 master data; gs1:productID is the property stand-in for that identity.

properties.label: Zipcode
properties.comment: ContactInformation element (ECLASS AAO129): postal code. Filled verbatim from the GS1 postal address postal code.
